{"id":"flying-shuttle-7p6","title":"Add .embed TSV → .fembed converter to embed.py","description":"Add a --convert subcommand to python/embed.py that reads one or more existing .embed TSV files (columns: file_name, start_token, embedding, text) and writes them as .fembed binary files without re-running the model.

Usage: python embed.py --convert --embed-file foo.embed [--out-file foo.fembed]
       python embed.py --convert --embed-dir ./embeddings/  (batch convert *.embed in dir)

Implementation:
- Parse the TSV with csv.reader (tab delimiter), skip header row
- For each row: source_file=col[0], start_token=int(col[1]), embedding=[float(x) for x in col[2].split(',')], text=col[3]
- Detect dims from first row's embedding length
- Call write_fembed() with the collected records (already implemented)
- Default output: same path with .fembed extension replacing .embed

Edge cases: handle csv.field_size_limit (already set), skip empty rows, validate header, warn on dim mismatch across rows.

This enables zero-recompute migration of existing .embed files to the binary format for ingestion via POST /api/v1/ingest/embed-file.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","owner":"biorisk@users.noreply.github.com","created_at":"2026-03-01T23:48:33Z","created_by":"biorisk","updated_at":"2026-03-01T23:48:33Z"}
